title: The Longest No. 1 Song Ever Is From THIS Year 🎤 #shorts
description:
How many weeks did the longest No. 1 song ever stay on top? Comment your guess.

Ella Langley's "Choosin' Texas" first hit No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 in February 2026 and kept climbing back. By the chart dated 7 Nov 2026 it had 26 total weeks at No. 1, more than any song in Hot 100 history (Mariah Carey's Christmas hit: 22; Old Town Road and A Bar Song: 19).

Sources: Music Times (7 Nov 2026 chart), Wikipedia list of 2026 Hot 100 number ones (Billboard citations)
